description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'ResetDatabaseController' within the OrangeHRM framework, specifically for handling requests to reset the database during functional testing. classes.name: ResetDatabaseController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for resetting the database to its initial state during functional testing. It handles incoming requests, invokes the database restore service, and returns a JSON response with the number of tables restored.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request by restoring the database to an initial save point and returning a response containing the count of affected tables.
